message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (~182 g) typically contains **about 95 kilocalories** (kcal).  
Calories can vary slightly:

| Apple Size | Approximate Weight | Calories |
|------------|--------------------|----------|
| Small      | ~150 g             | 80–85    |
| Medium     | ~182 g             | 90–100   |
| Large      | ~250 g             | 110–120  |

These figures assume a standard “red delicious” or similar variety without added sugars or toppings. If you’re tracking nutrition precisely, it’s best to weigh your specific fruit and refer to a reliable food database.
